def extract_code(raw_completion: str, prompt: str) -> str:
    code = raw_completion.rstrip()  # 只去尾部空白，保留前导缩进
    
    # Strip markdown fences if present
    if code.lstrip().startswith("```"):
        lines = code.split("\n")
        # Find opening fence
        start = 0
        for i, line in enumerate(lines):
            if line.strip().startswith("```"):
                start = i + 1
                break
        # Find closing fence
        end = len(lines)
        for i in range(len(lines) - 1, start - 1, -1):
            if lines[i].strip() == "```":
                end = i
                break
        code = "\n".join(lines[start:end])
    
    # If the completion contains the full function signature, use as-is
    entry_sig = prompt.strip().split("\n")[0]
    if entry_sig in code:
        return code
    
    # Check if code needs indentation (function body should be indented)
    code_lines = code.split("\n")
    non_empty_lines = [l for l in code_lines if l.strip()]
    if non_empty_lines and not non_empty_lines[0].startswith("    "):

        code = "\n".join(

            for line in code_lines

    # Ensure prompt ends with newline before appending body
